changelog:
WHAT'S NEW IN VISTA WATCH 1.0.12
• Improved playback and catalog recovery, confirmed working in our latest device testing.
• Refined TV navigation and playback-source controls.
• Official Help & Support with reviewable problem reports and a TV support QR.
• Clearer login error dialogs with recovery actions.
• Expanded avatars, refreshed artwork and consistent Vista Watch identity.

QUICK TIPS
• TV: press Menu or hold OK during playback to choose a source, change next-episode autoplay or open help. Back returns to video. Embedded providers may need Play next episode manually.
• Mobile: Settings > Account > Edit Avatar changes your avatar.
• Settings > Help & Support > Report a problem lets you review a report before sending it in your email app. Nothing is sent automatically.
• Download the update, then approve the Android installation prompt. Install over your existing app.

Full changelog and guide: https://www.lxobsidianportal.co.za/vista-1-0-12
Stream availability remains provider-dependent. Thank you for helping improve Vista Watch!
